summary: HyOrc Corp filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, reporting a September 13, 2026 First Amendment to a Promissory Note and Securities Purchase Agreement with GS Capital Partners, LLC. The $150,000 note's maturity was extended from September 13, 2026 to March 13, 2027; $15,000 was added to principal, raising the balance to $165,000, still bearing 12% interest. GS Capital's 250,000 shares ceased to be returnable and remain its property. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch dilution and default risk.
